diagnosis: The session touch endpoint calls redisStore.touch on req.params.sessionId without validating whether the requesting caller owns the target session or has customer support authorization. An attacker can repeatedly touch compromised or stale sessions belonging to another user, preventing automated inactivity timeouts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/support/sessions/sess_target_admin_77810/touch HTTP/1.1
Host: api.cloud.internal:8001
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aattacker_session_cookie
Accept: application/json
